_comment: Cyber, trust and key management product catalog.
ePAM has its own division and is untouched. The hand-authored
security_appliances and physical_security directories are left as written.

products.title: Secure Boot Subsystems
products.overview: Secure boot subsystem enforcing a verified boot chain from immutable ROM through bootloader to application, with measurements extended into a TPM at each stage. Rollback protection uses a monotonic counter in secure storage, so a signed-but-old image with a known vulnerability cannot be replayed onto the device.
specs: Immutable boot ROM with OTP-fused public key hash
ECDSA P-384 with SHA-384 image digest
PCR extension into TPM 2.0 at each boot stage
Monotonic counter in OTP, 64 update slots
180ms from reset to verified application entry
A/B image slots with automatic fallback on failed attestation
pcb: TPM SPI bus routed on inner layers only

bom.description: Signing key store and monotonic counter

products.title: Hardware Root of Trust

readme.category: Silicon root of trust and identity

products.overview: Hardware root of trust providing device identity, key derivation and platform attestation from an SRAM physically unclonable function. No private key is ever stored: the identity is reconstructed from silicon variation at each boot and erased on power-down, so extracting flash yields nothing usable.
specs: None persistent; keys derived per boot and zeroised
DICE layered attestation with per-layer CDI
DPA-resistant AES with masking and shuffling
pcb: Secret routing confined to inner layers under ground pour

bom.description: SRAM PUF root of trust processor

products.title: Hardware Security Modules
products.overview: Network-attached hardware security module performing key generation, storage and cryptographic operations inside a tamper-responsive boundary. Sustains 12000 ECDSA P-256 signatures per second with keys that provably never leave the enclosure in plaintext form.
specs: 8192 key slots, wrapped under a master key held in PUF
RSA-4096, ECDSA/ECDH P-521, AES-256, SHA-3, HMAC
Active mesh, zeroise in <50ms on breach
pcb: ENIG, potted in opaque tamper-evident epoxy
6-layer active tamper mesh enclosing the crypto boundary

products.title: TPM Modules
products.overview: Discrete TPM 2.0 module in the standard pin-header form factors, providing measured boot, sealed storage and remote attestation for platforms whose SoC lacks a firmware TPM. Supplied in SPI and LPC variants so it drops into existing mainboard headers without redesign.
specs: RSA-2048, ECC P-256, AES-128, SHA-256, HMAC
TCG certified, Common Criteria EAL4+ chip

products.title: Key Management Appliances
products.overview: Key management appliance handling generation, distribution, rotation and destruction across an enterprise fleet, speaking KMIP to storage arrays and PKCS#11 to applications. Key state is replicated across a quorum so no single appliance loss destroys material, which is the failure mode that makes teams avoid rotation.
specs: Master key in secure element, DEK/KEK envelope
Policy-driven automatic rotation with grace windows
pcb: Chassis intrusion switch wired to zeroise logic

products.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography Accelerators
products.overview: Post-quantum cryptography accelerator implementing ML-KEM and ML-DSA in FPGA fabric, sized for the large key and signature objects those schemes require. Supports hybrid classical-plus-PQC handshakes so deployment does not depend on the peer having migrated first.

bom.description: Key custodian and side-channel hardened control
Large PQC key object working memory

products.title: Zero Trust Gateways
products.overview: Zero trust network gateway enforcing per-session identity, device posture and policy before any traffic reaches a protected segment. Device posture is attested cryptographically rather than asserted, so a compromised endpoint cannot simply claim to be healthy.
specs: TI AM6254 quad Cortex-A53 with crypto offload
Per-session identity, device posture and context evaluation
Remote attestation of endpoint TPM quotes
Per-flow decision log to signed append-only store

products.title: OT Security Appliances
products.overview: Operational technology security appliance performing passive protocol inspection and enforced segmentation for industrial networks. Deep packet inspection covers Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850 and PROFINET, and the default deployment is passive tap so introducing it cannot itself halt a process line.
specs: Modbus TCP/RTU, DNP3, IEC 61850 MMS/GOOSE, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP
Passive tap, inline bridge, or enforced segmentation
pcb: Isolated serial field ports for surge survivability
compliance: System security requirements and security levels

products.title: Tamper Detection Subsystems
products.overview: Board-level tamper detection subsystem monitoring enclosure switches, light ingress, temperature excursion and supply glitching, with an event log that survives power loss. Distinct from the anti-tamper response subsystem: this detects and records, leaving the response policy to the protected system.
specs: Enclosure switch, ambient light, temperature, supply glitch, mesh
<5ms from event to logged and signalled
FRAM, 4096 timestamped events, survives power loss
Open-drain alarm, I2C status, zeroise strobe
pcb: Mesh sense traces on layers 2 and 7

bom.description: Enclosure opening and light ingress detection

products.title: Secure Element Modules
products.overview: Pluggable secure element carrier providing device authentication, secure key storage and attestation for products that cannot justify a full HSM. Three device options are pin-compatible on one carrier so a design can move up or down the cost and assurance curve without a board respin.
specs: Up to 48 key slots depending on device fitted
Mutual authentication with certificate chain validation
I2C with shielded connection, up to 1MHz
pcb: I2C shielded by guard traces tied to ground

products.title: Remote Attestation Appliances
products.overview: Attestation verifier appraising evidence from a device fleet against reference values and issuing signed attestation results. Implements the IETF RATS role split, so relying parties consume a short-lived result rather than parsing raw TPM quotes themselves.
specs: IETF RATS verifier role per RFC 9334
TPM 2.0 quotes, DICE certificates, ARM PSA tokens
Nonce and epoch-based, configurable validity window
pcb: Signing key confined to secure element, never in DRAM

bom.description: Reference value and appraisal log storage

products.title: Digital Forensic Appliances
products.overview: Forensic acquisition appliance imaging storage media through a hardware write blocker, computing hashes inline so integrity is established during capture rather than afterwards. The write block is enforced in hardware on the bus, not by driver configuration, which is what makes the resulting image defensible.
specs: Hardware-enforced on SATA, NVMe, USB and SAS
480 MB/s sustained to E01 or raw image
Concurrent MD5, SHA-1 and SHA-256 during capture
Signed acquisition log with operator identity
pcb: Write-block logic in fabric, no firmware bypass path
compliance: Integrating forensic techniques into incident response
Identification, collection and preservation of evidence

products.title: Supply Chain Trust Systems
products.overview: Supply chain trust station verifying component provenance at goods-in, combining cryptographic authentication of parts that support it with X-ray and thermal signature comparison for those that do not. Counterfeit detection matters most for the legacy parts that carry no secure element at all.
specs: Challenge-response for parts with a secure element
MLX90640 thermal profile comparison under load
Die marking and package surface comparison
Signed SBOM/HBOM entry per verified lot
240 components per hour for full verification
